bsi.editorial_reason: Job 26:7 speaks of the northern sky spread over empty space: the Hebrew directional word north does not name the distinct Mount Zaphon location. The source-created mountain interpretation remains potentially relevant to other poetic mountain imagery but cannot be asserted for this cosmological description.
editorial_evidence: Pinned WLC Job 26:7 refers to the north as a direction in a cosmological description, not to a named mountain
Mount Zaphon is preserved as a distinct identity for separately assessed poetic contexts
